research_question: Can a reusable projective discharge mechanism with a low-dimensional monotone mechanism clock and probe-certified fallback outperform matched five-probe local interpolation on unseen physical battery cells?

dataset.name: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence Battery Data Set
dataset.payload_access_rule: The development job may extract only B0005.mat and B0006.mat. The holdout job is a separate job and may extract B0007.mat and B0018.mat only after a hashed candidate lock is produced by a passing development job.

physical_coordinate.name: absolute_discharged_charge_Ah
physical_coordinate.definition: q_Ah = cumulative trapezoidal integral of abs(Current_measured) over Time divided by 3600
physical_coordinate.forbidden_normalization: No per-trajectory output normalization or trajectory-specific error scale is permitted.
physical_coordinate.mechanism_clock: s = sigmoid(alpha + beta * logit(clamp(q / C_probe, eps, 1-eps)))
physical_coordinate.probe_capacity_estimate: C_probe is the robust median of q_probe / probe_fraction over the five predeclared probes.

cycle_selection.selection_if_over_limit: evenly spaced by discharge-cycle order, including endpoints

probes.selection: nearest unique sample indices by rank; no output-value-dependent placement
probes.scoring: all finite non-probe samples; tail is every scored sample after the final probe

mechanism_library.projective_preprocessing: Subtract each training curve's endpoint chord, L2-normalize the nonlinear residual, align sign to a running template, then use the pointwise median as h0.
mechanism_library.transport_basis: h1 is the normalized derivative of h0 with respect to logit(s), orthogonalized against h0. The candidate uses h0(phi)+tau*h1(phi).

candidate_search.development_selection: Choose one configuration solely by leave-one-cell-out development performance on B0005/B0006, minimizing geometric-mean safe-candidate/local error ratio subject to all development risk gates.
candidate_search.target_fit: For each fixed transport tuple, solve output-specific ridge coefficients for 1, s, and the transported nonlinear mechanism using only probe observations. Clock, tangent, and thermal lag are shared across voltage and temperature.
candidate_search.safe_fallback: Choose a convex blend between transported mechanism and the matched local control from lambda in [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1] using leave-one-probe-out error plus the frozen blend penalty. Lambda=0 is the exact local fallback.

matched_controls.local_control: For each output independently, choose PCHIP or a degree-3 polynomial by leave-one-probe-out error, then refit that family on all five probes.
matched_controls.fixed_clock_control: Same projective mechanism and write fit with alpha=0, beta=1, tau=0, temperature_lag=0 and no transported clock search.
matched_controls.direct_polynomial_control: Joint context-free degree-3 output polynomials using the same five probes.

metrics.tail_joint_error: same fixed-scale metric on scored samples after the final probe
metrics.aggregate_ratio: candidate error divided by matched local-control error, aggregated by median, geometric mean, win fraction, and 90th percentile
metrics.catastrophic: nonfinite prediction or cycle_joint_error greater than max(0.50, 4 times local-control error)

evidence_policy.development_failure: Do not open B0007 or B0018; preserve the negative result.
evidence_policy.holdout_failure: Preserve the first result permanently; any later model work treats B0007/B0018 as consumed development data and must reserve new cells before payload access.
evidence_policy.reruns: No rerun of the frozen holdout is permitted for scientific decision making.
